Package org.yuemi.libs.api.gui

Record Class SlotBehavior

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
org.yuemi.libs.api.gui.SlotBehavior
public record SlotBehavior(boolean allowPickup, boolean allowPlace, boolean allowShift, boolean allowDrag) extends Record
Per-slot interaction behavior configuration. Controls which player actions are allowed on a specific GUI slot.
